change: Increase number_of_fresh_channels_at_verify_time from 2 to 4, and ensure the fresh channels include at least one with a very small window (window=2 or 3) and one with a very large absolute signal range (e.g., [-1000, 1000]), so that a partially-correct alpha or initialization fix that happens to pass pressure and temp by coincidence will be exposed by edge-case window sizes and signal magnitudes.
expected_effect: Agents that fix only one of the two EMA bugs or produce a non-general fix (e.g., hard-coded constants or a fix that accidentally compensates) will fail on the additional fresh channels with extreme window sizes and signal ranges, reducing the pass rate from 5/5 to approximately 2/5.
